data.long_meaning: Goddess of Love and Compassion. The name Premika carries the meaning “Goddess of Love” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Premika total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
